content: <thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M+H = 127.0997 → neutral M ≈ 126.099 Da) the molecular formula is likely C₇H₁₀O₂ (DBE = 3). The IR shows a broad O–H stretch (~3500 cm⁻¹) and carbonyl absorptions (1704, 1681 cm⁻¹), consistent with a carboxylic acid that also contains one C=C double bond (ring + C=C + C=O = 3 DBE). A structure that fits these constraints is cyclohex‑1‑ene‑1‑carboxylic acid, whose SMILES is **O=C(O)C1=CCCCC1**. I will validate this SMILES and obtain its molecular formula to confirm the match.
